name: Enroll & scope
short: Who may see and do what?
why: An account, connector credential and business authority are different things. A common owner does not erase business boundaries.
inputs: User identity, device identity, business membership, intended audience and nominated recovery owner.
mechanism: Authenticate outside the model. Establish an explicit active business and purpose. Record current grants and source-sharing scope; recheck access when reading or acting. Show what is connected and who can see derived content. Pilot staffing remains unconfirmed.
outputs: Scoped principal and device session; enrollment and source-policy records.
connections: Scopes BP02–BP12. Revocation invalidates affected access and derived views; pending work goes to an authorized reassignment path.
reuse: Established identity/secret primitives; Glen audience boundaries; Executor credential-policy separation.
build: GoFathom membership, audience mapping, recovery and revocation behaviour.
skip: Maximum permissions as the default; credentials in prompts; owner access automatically becoming group access.
sprint: S0 boundary audit; S1 isolation; S3 departure/recovery.
acceptance: Switch Consu to ForeFathers, revoke a grant and reopen an old answer: no forbidden content or stale privileged action.
varun: Varun can privately view both businesses; a Consu staff answer uses Consu-approved context.
ramya: Ramya coordinates assigned matters; private principal notes remain restricted.
status: Not audited in the current implementation
code_evidence: S0 must supply repository, commit, path/symbol, actual app-path trace and reproduction evidence.

name: Connect & synchronize
why: The assistant must distinguish a healthy source from partial, stale or disconnected coverage.
inputs: Scoped enrollment, WhatsApp session or provider access, Gmail authorization, source selection and sync policy.
mechanism: Use replaceable adapters with credentials held by the execution boundary. Register permitted sources, sync checkpoints, duplicates and gaps. Reconnect without broadening grants. The user-reported WhatsApp online-session approach is a candidate integration, not a verified reliable product connector.
outputs: Source envelopes with external IDs, account, audience, event/receipt times, revision and coverage markers.
connections: Feeds BP03; coverage changes notify BP06/BP07 and affected absence conclusions. Outbound communication is a separate BP09 capability.
reuse: Executor/Nango integration patterns; Inkbox identity/inbox lessons where applicable.
build: Actual WhatsApp and Gmail adapter lifecycle, consent, gap reporting and operator recovery.
skip: Assuming every group API is available; treating a connected account as complete historical access.
sprint: S0 inspect actual adapters; S1 selected intake; broader connectors later.
acceptance: Disconnect, backfill an older message and replay a duplicate: show the gap, retain the late evidence and create no duplicate logical event.
varun: Receiving group and accountant-only email remain separate sources.
ramya: Court inbox coverage includes attachment processing state, not only latest email date.
status: Not audited in the current implementation
code_evidence: S0 must supply repository, commit, path/symbol, actual app-path trace and reproduction evidence.

name: Capture evidence
why: Summaries cannot be the only retained record of a disputed quantity or instruction.
inputs: Messages, replies, attachments, photos, voice notes, documents and permitted device observations.
mechanism: Preserve source references and revisions; extract typed observations with spans or media timestamps and extractor versions. Track pending/failed assets. Treat source text as data, never as an instruction granting tool access. Voice notes arrive early; broader video/browser capture is task-scoped and later as needed.
outputs: Evidence IDs, extraction candidates, media references, processing status and provenance.
connections: Feeds BP04 and exact evidence lookup in BP07. Newly processed assets trigger scoped re-evaluation even if their source date is old.
reuse: Docling-style extraction; Sidekick frontline-media UX; screenpipe selective capture lessons.
build: Evidence envelope, parser isolation, media provenance and retry/failure visibility.
skip: Continuous blanket capture; assuming a transcript faithfully preserves numbers or negation.
sprint: S1 evidence path; S2 early voice; targeted video/desktop capture deferred.
acceptance: A voice note says “not twenty, twelve”; preserve the original, flag critical ambiguity and do not post twenty automatically.
varun: Chef voice note and receipt photo remain inspectable together.
ramya: Court PDF revision and email envelope remain distinct evidence.
status: Not audited in the current implementation
code_evidence: S0 must supply repository, commit, path/symbol, actual app-path trace and reproduction evidence.

name: Understand the situation
short: Which business event does this mean?
why: Fragmented conversation needs interpretation; matching a name or PO number is not enough.
inputs: New observations, reply chains, scoped entity directory, relevant history and permitted knowledge from BP06.
mechanism: Use exact keys/replies first, then bounded text, entity, time and semantic retrieval. Keep candidate relationships separate from admitted links. Consider closed episodes. Investigate first; ask the best-placed authorized person only if the uncertainty matters. Store a clarification fingerprint and relevant source versions so unchanged questions are not repeated.
outputs: Evidence-linked interpretation, candidate links, explicit unknowns and a scoped clarification request when needed.
connections: Proposals go to BP05. Knowledge assists interpretation but cannot establish truth by repetition. Corrections may re-open this stage from BP12.
reuse: Asakana scoped customer understanding; Glen context; Hermes context-engine patterns.
build: Business-specific interpretation and episode linking; question routing, dedupe, aging and changed-evidence handling.
skip: PO equality as automatic delivery merge; every ambiguity going to the owner; confidence alone as admission.
sprint: S1 core interpretation; S2 historical corrections and clarification behaviour.
acceptance: Two deliveries share a PO; “remaining came” stays ambiguous, then “other outlet” must not resolve either wrongly.
varun: Ask the receiving manager which delivery, without inventing completion.
ramya: Distinguish similarly numbered matters across courts; do not merge clients.
status: Not audited in the current implementation
code_evidence: S0 must supply repository, commit, path/symbol, actual app-path trace and reproduction evidence.

name: Admit & calculate
why: A plausible explanation must not silently become stock, money, a deadline or completion.
inputs: Typed proposals, authoritative source references, current policy, exact units and relevant record versions.
mechanism: Apply deterministic checks and scoped admission policy. Ordinary valid cases can follow a quiet path; not every admission requires the owner. Preserve disagreements. Commit the state change and downstream notification atomically where the existing store supports it. Keep external stock/accounting authority unless an explicit migration exists.
outputs: Admitted record revision or a held/rejected proposal; shared version-bound quantities and critical statuses.
connections: Feeds BP06, BP08, BP10 and BP11. A current record version is rechecked before consequential actions.
reuse: Existing verified TypeScript/PostgreSQL components; Marble/Definite record discipline.
build: Minimal domain schema and checks, shared calculation result and authority contracts.
skip: Vector search as ledger; prose arithmetic; a general accounting engine for the first pilot.
sprint: S0 locate existing code; S1 repair real app path.
acceptance: Duplicate receipt does not double-count; incompatible units remain unresolved; ordinary complete delivery creates no false alert.
varun: Accepted received quantity and invoice discrepancy stay distinct.
ramya: An admitted notice update revises the relevant matter record; narrative alone does not change its date.
status: Not audited in the current implementation

name: Maintain understanding
short: What have we learned about this business?
why: Useful context should accumulate across episodes without becoming a competing source of truth.
inputs: Permitted evidence, admitted records, decisions, scoped preferences/rules, corrected relationships and verified outcomes.
mechanism: Create selective derived briefs for useful entities. Separate accepted facts, tentative interpretations, approved procedures and narrative synthesis. Invalidate on relevant source, extraction, grant or policy change. Refresh critical dependencies before reliance; batch or lazily refresh descriptive history. Keep prior versions and never count generated text as new independent evidence.
outputs: Permission-bearing, source-linked knowledge views with coverage, freshness and open questions; proposed patterns remain labelled.
connections: Feeds BP04 interpretation, BP07 answers and BP11 inspection. BP05 remains record authority. BP12 may propose reviewed procedural changes.
reuse: Glen lineage and reusable knowledge; Asakana inspectable customer knowledge; Karpathy maintained synthesis pattern.
build: One supplier brief lifecycle first, selected by use and update cost; entity/matter views over existing storage.
skip: A second ledger, global memory, eager rewrite of every page, a mandatory graph database or new wiki vendor.
sprint: S0 locate reusable persistence; S1 shared interfaces; S2 one bounded brief; S4 benchmark before expansion.
acceptance: After corrected deliveries, answer a fresh related question using updated history; no stale quantity, repeated question or restricted detail.
varun: Supplier brief connects past delivery issues and the current agreement without claiming a proposed ban is policy.
ramya: Matter brief preserves chronology, decisions and open questions; current notice/date comes from its authoritative record.
status: Not audited in the current implementation
code_evidence: S0 must supply repository, commit, path/symbol, actual app-path trace and reproduction evidence.

name: Assemble context
short: What does this request need now?
why: Accumulating knowledge is only useful if the assistant selects current, permitted, relevant context.
inputs: User question/command, intended audience, active business, fresh records, knowledge candidates and source health.
mechanism: Choose a bounded packet from authorized records, briefs and original evidence. For consequential current facts, check the current record and dependencies. A stale brief can guide further lookup but must not support an unqualified current claim. Reveal relevant missing coverage without disclosing forbidden material.
outputs: Context packet with selected IDs/versions, citations, limitations and budget usage.
connections: Questions can go directly to BP11; commands go to BP08. Additional evidence can route back to BP04. No need to traverse the entire belt per query.
reuse: Hermes context assembly; Glen scoped recall and visible context panel.
build: Current-policy retrieval, fallback when knowledge is stale/unavailable, per-business cache keys.
skip: Loading the entire wiki; filtering only after protected content reaches a model.
sprint: S1 bounded context; S2 brief-assisted retrieval.
acceptance: Answer “what remains outstanding?” with current quantities; with revoked accountant access, reconstruct the allowed answer.
varun: Explain supplier history plus current shortage using the right outlet.
ramya: A new assistant receives a permitted matter summary, not all principal correspondence.
status: Not audited in the current implementation
code_evidence: S0 must supply repository, commit, path/symbol, actual app-path trace and reproduction evidence.

name: Plan & authorize
why: Understanding, user intent and authority must meet before a business effect occurs.
inputs: Typed request, context packet, proposed effect, current record/policy versions and task owner.
mechanism: Select a reviewed procedure when applicable; otherwise propose bounded steps. Separate answering, drafting and executing. Bind approvals to the exact effect and relevant versions. A changed dependency causes revalidation, not approval reuse. Business policy can permit routine low-risk work without repetitive owner approval.
outputs: Authorized effect intent, held proposal or an answer-only route; expected outcome and evidence predicate.
connections: Dispatch authorized work to BP09; hand human-owned work to BP10; drafts go to BP11 with status.
reuse: Decawork review separation; GrepAI procedure contracts; Executor scoped tool access.
build: GoFathom action gateway, approval identity, pending intent and cancellation semantics.
skip: A review LLM overriding hard denies; old approval covering a new quantity or recipient.
sprint: S1 identify boundaries; S2 commands; S3 complete action loop.
acceptance: Change a delivery relationship after approval: the previous approval cannot authorize the changed effect.
varun: Draft a supplier follow-up; sending requires the authorized channel and current scope.
ramya: Assign matter work only with appropriate evidence, assignee access and authority.
status: Not audited in the current implementation
code_evidence: S0 must supply repository, commit, path/symbol, actual app-path trace and reproduction evidence.

name: Execute & reconcile
why: Tool success, network acknowledgement and business success are different events.
inputs: Authorized effect intent with idempotency key, tool arguments, target and expected result.
mechanism: Prefer structured APIs. Use browser execution when justified, with scoped credentials and evidence of the result. Persist intent before dispatch. On ambiguous timeout, mark outcome unknown and reconcile before retrying. Keep cloud work durable when a device sleeps. Do not treat a terminal becoming idle as business completion.
outputs: Effect receipt, verified external reference, failure or explicit unknown outcome.
connections: Feeds BP10 verification and BP11 progress. Failures return to an authorized recovery route, not blind retries.
reuse: Executor tool access; Agent37 environment patterns; Terse state ownership; herdr progress and recovery UX.
build: Effect identity, reconciliation and scoped tool adapters using the existing harness where verified.
skip: Exactly-once claims across arbitrary APIs; permanent privileged browser sessions; automatic repeated sends.
sprint: S2 internal artifacts; S3 authorized effects/recovery; wider tooling deferred.
acceptance: Provider accepts an action then times out: reconcile to one effect rather than create a duplicate.
varun: Create a versioned report now; external supplier messages remain separately authorized.
ramya: Provide permitted attachments with assignment and verify the target result.
status: Not audited in the current implementation

name: Follow through
why: An assistant must remember commitments and distinguish acknowledgement from completion.
inputs: Task version, assigned person, due/next-check time, required evidence, effect outcomes and business policy.
mechanism: Keep durable waiting states, owner and next check. A view is not acknowledgement; acknowledgement is not completion. Close only the relevant obligation with evidence and authority. Separate replacement received, credit accepted, accepted loss, corrected finding and partial/unresolved states. Recovery and staff departure preserve unresolved work.
outputs: Verified task outcome or explicitly pending obligation, with chronology and resolution evidence.
connections: Updates BP05 records as permitted, BP06 history and BP11 attention views. Later correction can reopen affected work.
reuse: Praxis ownership/readiness; Marble receipt/billing distinction; herdr status visibility.
build: GoFathom discrepancy/task predicates and minimal reminder/recovery behaviour.
skip: A generic “closed” flag; credit as replenishment; automatic reminders without configured authority.
sprint: S1 manager acknowledgement trial; S3 full durable loop.
acceptance: Credit resolves the matching billing issue but physical shortage stays open; departure cannot orphan the task silently.
varun: Receiving manager confirms replacement; accountant handles credit separately.
ramya: Acknowledged assignment remains open until its required work evidence exists.
status: Not audited in the current implementation
code_evidence: S0 must supply repository, commit, path/symbol, actual app-path trace and reproduction evidence.

name: Explain & deliver
why: The same business state should not produce conflicting chat, PDF and voice answers.
inputs: Version-bound critical result, authorized evidence, knowledge view, task state and audience.
mechanism: Render the same quantities/statuses across answers, reports and voice. Show evidence, uncertainty, last refresh and pending work. Provide a change explanation linking affected knowledge, records, tasks and outputs. Keep historical reports immutable and mark tracked copies stale/superseded; downloaded copies cannot be recalled.
outputs: Audience-appropriate answer, knowledge view, report or readback with provenance and currentness.
connections: User corrections return to BP04/BP12. Repeated useful questions may nominate a BP06 brief; an answer never becomes independent evidence.
reuse: Asakana knowledge inspection; Glen context panel; Sidekick low-friction staff interaction.
build: Readable domain views and consistent rendering over the shared calculation/state output.
skip: Separate prose patches for each modality; exposing implementation jargon to restaurant staff.
sprint: S2 answers, commands, voice and reports; S3 progress experience.
acceptance: Correct a receipt: chat/PDF/voice use the same new values; old report is retained and labelled superseded.
varun: “What changed?” identifies the corrected outlet and remaining shortage.
ramya: Ramya sees revised notice, affected assignment and unresolved questions together.
status: Not audited in the current implementation

name: Correct & improve
short: Will the next interaction be better?
why: Learning must persist at the right scope and be tested without inventing global rules.
inputs: Corrections, reviewer decisions, verified outcomes, recurring questions and production failures when authorized.
mechanism: Distinguish one-off fact correction, scoped alias/preference, operating rule and product/model change. Propagate affected state through existing controls. Suggest stable reusable knowledge or procedures, but promote consequential rules through review and tests. Keep evaluation families separate and record full cost and human effort.
outputs: Corrected record/brief or a reviewed candidate rule/procedure; regression fixture and release evidence.
connections: Feedback routes to BP04/BP05/BP06 and approved procedures in BP08. BP01 permissions remain in force.
reuse: Asakana scoped correction; GrepAI reusable procedures; Hue incident-to-test learning; Rystic stateful test environments.
build: Traceable learning lifecycle, versioned changes, evaluation and rollback—not automatic weight training.
skip: Treating one success as policy; tuning on held-out cases; cross-tenant learning without authorization.
sprint: S1 capture corrections; S2 scoped propagation; S4 generalization and economics.
acceptance: “This delivery only” changes one case; “Consu rule from now” needs scoped admission and cannot alter ForeFathers.
varun: Next supplier question benefits from corrected history without repeating a settled clarification.
ramya: New staff inherit approved matter context while departed staff lose access.
status: Not audited in the current implementation
